why: Calculate the cost of API calls to specific LLM models to enable cost tracking and billing functionality in the gateway.
what: Looks up model pricing information, applies default token counts when missing, and computes total cost by dividing token counts by 1 million and multiplying by per-token rates. Returns 0.01 as conservative estimate for unknown models.
how: Calls findPricing() to retrieve model rates, uses nullish coalescing to provide DEFAULT_INPUT_TOKENS and DEFAULT_OUTPUT_TOKENS when tokens are null, then calculates input and output costs separately and sums them.

inputs.name: model
inputs.constraints: Must be a recognized model key; unknown models trigger conservative 0.01 estimate

inputs.name: inputTokens
inputs.constraints: If null, defaults to DEFAULT_INPUT_TOKENS when outputTokens is also null, otherwise 0

inputs.name: outputTokens
inputs.constraints: If null, defaults to DEFAULT_OUTPUT_TOKENS when inputTokens is also null, otherwise 0

outputs.meaning: Total cost in currency units (dollars) for the API call with given token usage
